description: Known-answer vectors for envelope version 2, the chunked AEAD envelope of EncryptedMessageConnection. Each vector fixes (sessionKey, role, sequence, chunk size, plaintext) and records the exact envelope: version || seq || chunk_0 || ... || chunk_(n-1), each chunk AES-256-GCM ciphertext || 16-byte tag under IV_k and AAD_k below. The construction is specified in docs/spec/CHANNEL_SECURITY.md, 'The chunked envelope, version 2'. Regenerate with generate-aead-chunked-envelope-vectors.mjs in this directory.
envelopeLayout: version (1 byte) || seq (8 bytes, big-endian) || chunks; the plaintext type_tag || payload is cut into chunks of chunkBytes bytes, the last 1 to chunkBytes bytes.
additionalDataLayout: 14 bytes: version || uint64_be(seq) || uint32_be(chunk index) || final (0x01 on the last chunk, else 0x00).

keyDerivation.note: info = infoPrefix + context; the initiator sends under context 'initiator-to-responder'.

patternPayload: payloadPatternBytes N stands for N bytes, byte i being i % 251.

vectors.name: json-initiator-seq0
vectors.description: JSON object payload (type tag 0) from the initiator at sequence 0: one chunk, flagged final.

vectors.name: binary-responder-seq1
vectors.description: Uint8Array payload (type tag 1) from the responder at sequence 1, under the other directional key: one chunk.

vectors.name: binary-initiator-seq7-exact-chunks
vectors.description: An 11-byte Uint8Array at a chunk size of 4: a plaintext of 12 bytes, three full chunks with no empty fourth.

vectors.name: json-initiator-seq4328719365-short-last-chunk
vectors.description: A JSON object at a chunk size of 5 and sequence 0x0102030405, so the sequence number shows in each IV and the last chunk is short.

vectors.name: binary-initiator-seq2-one-chunk-and-one-byte
vectors.description: A Uint8Array of 16,777,216 bytes, byte i being i % 251, at the real chunk size: a plaintext of one chunk and one byte, recorded by the SHA-256 of the envelope and its last 32 bytes.
